originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
layout [direction: DOWN]
Client service as "Client App"
Gateway service as "API Gateway"
Auth service as "Auth Service"
Users service as "User Service"
Orders service as "Order Service"
Payments service as "Payment Service"
Inventory service as "Inventory Service"
Notify service as "Notification Service"
UserDB database as "User Database"
OrderDB database as "Order Database"
Stripe service as "Stripe API"

edge_1 = Client -> Gateway as "HTTPS request"
edge_2 = Gateway -> Auth as "authenticate"
edge_3 = Gateway -> Users as "route user request"
edge_4 = Gateway -> Orders as "route order request"
edge_5 = Auth -> UserDB as "verify credentials"
edge_6 = Users -> UserDB as "read/write profile"
edge_7 = Orders -> OrderDB as "persist order"
edge_8 = Orders -> Inventory as "check stock"
edge_9 = Orders -> Payments as "charge customer"
edge_10 = Payments -> Stripe as "process payment"
edge_11 = Orders -> Notify as "send confirmation"

injectedDefects.description: inserted a line break inside label "Inventory Service"
